Name: SOC 1 Type II (Financial Reporting & ICFR) for Oracle Fusion SaaS
Description: Comprehensive Service Organization Control (SOC 1 Type II) evaluation of controls relevant to Internal Control over Financial Reporting (ICFR) across Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP, HCM, SCM, and EPM. This is a platform-defined control set aligned with the named real regulatory framework's known objectives, not a verbatim transcription of an official published checklist — organizations achieve SOX 404 / SOC 1 / SoD compliance through their own internal controls program, not a single external document.

Requirements.Name: Logical Access Authorization & Role-Based Security
Requirements.Description: Access to financial application modules, database schemas, and administrative tools is restricted to authorized personnel based on job function.

Requirements.Name: Multi-Factor Authentication on Elevated Accounts
Requirements.Description: MFA is enforced for all users holding administrative privileges or performing direct financial transactions in Oracle Cloud.

Requirements.Name: Post-Implementation Consultant Role Sanitization
Requirements.Description: Implementation consultant superuser roles are revoked from operational accounts following system deployment and go-live.

Requirements.Name: Password Complexity and Authentication Rules
Requirements.Description: Identity Domain password rules enforce minimum length (>=14 chars), rotation intervals, history prevention, and lockout on failed attempts.

Requirements.Name: Privileged Identity Governance & Least Privilege
Requirements.Description: Superuser and administrative duty roles are granted on an exceptional, documented basis with periodic re-certification.

Requirements.Name: Inactive and Dormant Account Deprovisioning (>90 Days)
Requirements.Description: User accounts inactive for greater than 90 days are identified, reviewed, and suspended to prevent unauthorized access.

Requirements.Name: Timely Deprovisioning of Terminated Personnel
Requirements.Description: Terminated employee access is revoked from all Oracle Cloud services and IDCS identity domains promptly upon separation.

Requirements.Name: Periodic Access Re-certification & Entitlement Reviews
Requirements.Description: Business unit managers perform recurring reviews of assigned ERP duty roles and data access security contexts.

Requirements.Name: Procure-to-Pay (P2P) Segregation of Incompatible Duties
Requirements.Description: Duties in the AP and Purchasing cycles (vendor master, PO creation, invoice matching, payment disbursement) are segregated.

Requirements.Name: Record-to-Report (R2R) Segregation of Incompatible Duties
Requirements.Description: Duties in the General Ledger cycle (journal entry, journal approval, period close, COA maintenance) are segregated.

Requirements.Name: Order-to-Cash (O2C) Segregation of Incompatible Duties
Requirements.Description: Duties in the Receivables and Billing cycles (customer setup, credit limits, invoicing, cash application) are segregated.

Requirements.Name: Administrative vs Business Processing Segregation
Requirements.Description: Users holding Security Console administrative roles cannot hold transactional business posting privileges.

Requirements.Name: Audit Trail Configuration & Active Object-Level Logging
Requirements.Description: Oracle Fusion ERP audit policies are enabled and actively recording transactional changes across key financial modules.

Requirements.Name: Granular Financial Audit Trail Coverage Completeness
Requirements.Description: Audit policies capture insert, update, and delete actions with old/new values on all critical financial entities.

Requirements.Name: Security Administration & Role Modification Audit Trail
Requirements.Description: Modifications to role hierarchies, duty permissions, and security profiles are permanently recorded in the audit log.

Requirements.Name: Audit Log Retention & Protection from Tampering
Requirements.Description: Audit logs are retained for a minimum of 365 days and protected against unauthorized modification or deletion.

Requirements.Name: Network Perimeter Security & Corporate IP Ingress Filtering
Requirements.Description: Access to ERP interfaces and APIs is restricted to authorized corporate CIDRs via Network Perimeters and Sign-On Policies.

Requirements.Name: OAuth Integration Security & Scoped API Client Governance
Requirements.Description: OAuth Confidential Applications connecting to Oracle SaaS APIs are granted only the minimum required scopes.

Requirements.Name: Secure Communication Protocols & Cryptographic Controls
Requirements.Description: All communications with Oracle Cloud SaaS services use TLS 1.2+ encryption with strong cipher suites.
